input.question: Defend the Spend review of pr-015: please itemize the lab supplies and publication costs in this request with vendors and dates, and confirm each was allocable to R21AI182745 and placed before the project end date.

grant.title: Investigating ploidy modulation as a strategy to improve antibiotic activity

purchases.item: Open-access publication fee, J. Appl. Microb. Methods

answer.answer: Payment request pr-015 (period 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30, total $8,410) lists two items matching your question. Lab supplies: rq-033, Agar plates, 40 packs, from MicroMedia, ordered 2026-04-14, $1,180, invoice paid ($1,180, received 2026-04-20), serving the aim "Assay validation runs". Publication costs: rq-035, Open-access publication fee, J. Appl. Microb. Methods, from J. Appl. Microb. Methods, ordered 2026-04-24, $2,100, invoice paid ($2,100, received 2026-04-30), serving the aim "Publishing the beta-lactam assay paper". Project end date: both order dates are before the grant's project end date of 2026-08-31. Allocability: the records tie each purchase to a research aim under R21AI182745 (Investigating ploidy modulation as a strategy to improve antibiotic activity). The records do not include any further allocability documentation, so I can only point to those stated aims. Other items: the request also includes personnel rows for a research technician at 60% effort (pay-R21-2026-04-1, $2,880) and a graduate researcher at 50% effort (pay-R21-2026-04-2, $2,250), which are outside this question. The request shows 1 item left out, and the records do not say what it is, so I cannot describe it or say whether it is a lab supply or publication cost. The listed amounts do not by themselves account for the stated total, and I have not computed any reconciliation.
